definitions.full: H3548. kohen כֹּהֵן 750 noun masculine priest (Late Hebrew כֹּהֵן ; Aramaic כַּהֲנָא כָּהֵין, , , ; Ethiopic all id. ; on Phoenician and Arabic see above); — ׳כ Gen 14:18 439t.; plural כֹּהֲנִים Exod 19:6 272t.; construct כֹּהֲנֵי 1Sam 5:5 13t.; suffix כֹּהֲנַי Lam 1:19 22 t. suffixes — 1 priest-king: e.g. Melchizedek Gen 14:18 (E ?), compare Psa 110:4 (the Messianic priest-king like Melchizedek); Zech 6:13 (Messianic priest and king); Israel כֹּהֲנִים מַמְלֶכֶת Exod 19:6 (E) a kingdom of priests (priests and kings at once in their relation to the nations); compare Isa 61:6 (of Israel ministering as a priest); or a chieftain (exercising priestly functions) מִדְיָן כֹּהֵן Exod 2:16 ; 3:1 ; 18:1 (all J E); so also probably the sons of David 2Sam 8:18 , his grandson 1Kin 4:5 , and Ira the Jairite 2Sam 20:26 , who as princes performed priestly functions. With these we may class the כהנים Exod 19:22 , 24 (J). 2 priests of other religions than ׳י 's: Potiphera ׳כ אֹן Gen 41:45 , 50 (E), 46:20 (P); Egyptian כהנים 47:22 (twice in verse); 47:26 (J); ׳כ דָגוֺן 1Sam 5:5 ; Philistine וקסמים כהנים 6:2 ; כֹּהֲנָיו his priests: e.g. of Baal 2Kin 10:19 +? 10:11 ; of Chemosh Jer 48:7 ; of Malcam 49:3 ; Mattan was ׳כ הבעל 2Kin 11:18 2Chr 23:17 ; הכהנים עם הכמרים Zeph 1:4 ; Josiah burned the bones of the priests of the Baalim and Asherim 2Chr 34:5 . 3 priests of special orders in Israel: a. 16:15-16 , Isa 8:2 ; Hilkiah of Josiah 2Kin 22:10 , 12 , 14 ; 23:24 ; 2Chr 34:14 , 18 . Other individual priests are named, e.g.: Pashhur of Jehoiachin Jer 20:1 ; Zephaniah of Zedekiah 21:1 ; 29:25-26 , 29 ; 37:3 ; ׳הַכּ is Ezekiel's title Ezek 1:3 . Priests are classed with officials of state: prophets and priests 2Kin 23:2 ; Isa 28:7 ; Jer 5:31 ; 6:13 ; 8:10 ; 14:18 ; 23:11 , 33 , 34 ; 26:7-8 , 11 , 16 ; 29:1 ; Lam 2:20 ; 4:13 ; priests and elders 1:19 ; 4:16 ; king and priest 2:6 ; kings, priests, and prophets Jer 13:13 ; kings, princes, and priests 1:18 ; princes, eunuchs, and priests 34:19 ; priest, sage, and prophet 18:18 ; chiefs, priests, and prophets Micah 3:11 ; prophets, priests, and elders Ezek 7:26 ; kings, princes, priests, and prophets Jer 2:26 ; 4:9 ; 8:1 ; 32:32 ; princes, judges, prophets, and priests Zeph 3:4 ; seeming to exclude any other officials. Apparently in the same Generic sense הכהנים Jer 1:1 ; 2:8 ; 27:16 ; 28:1 , 5 ; 29:25 ; 31:14 ; כַּכֹּהֵן Isa 24:2 ; כהנים Job 12:19 ; כהניה Lam 1:4 ; Ezek 22:26 ; כהניו Psa 78:64 . Moses and Aaron among his priests 99:6 includes Moses (against P). Zion's priests clothed with righteousness and salvation 132:9 ; 132:16 2Chr 6:41 , probably here also. 5 Levitical priests הַלְוִיִּם הַכֹּהֲנִים Deut 17:9 , 18 ; 18:1 ; 24:8 ; 27:9 ; Josh 3:3 ; 8:33 (all D), Jer 33:18 (inverted), 33:21 (neither in ᵐ5 ), 2Chr 5:5 (= ׳וְהַלּ ׳הַכּ 1Kin 8:4 : Chronicler retains original Deuteronomic reading), Ezek 43:19 ; 44:15 (compare 6 ); ׳הַכּ לִוֵי בְּנֵי Deut 21:5 ; 31:9 ; לכ ׳לקח ׳לל Isa 66:21 take for priests, for Levites (of the nations in Messianic age). Doubtless of same class are: הַכֹּהֲנִים Deut 18:3 ; 19:17 ; Josh 3:6 , 8 ; 4:11 (D); and הַכֹּהֵן , the priest officiating on a particular occasion Deut 18:3 ; 20:2 ; or holding a particular dignity 17:12 ; 26:3-4 ,. The כהנים of the other cities of Judah, ׳כ הבמות , who were not allowed to minister in Jerusalem 2Kin 23:8 (twice in verse); 23:9 , 20 , may be an attempt to enforce an exclusion from the priesthood of all but Levitical priests. 6 Zadokite priests: Ezekiel distinguishes among הלוים הכהנים those of the seed of Zadok, צָדוֺק בְּנֵי ; all but the latter excluded by him from priesthood Ezek 40:46 ; 43:19 ; 44:15 ; 48:11 ; the priests of his code being all Zadokites 40:45-46 , 42:13-14 , 43:24 , 27 ; 44:21-22 , 30 (twice in verse); 44:31 ; 45:4 , 19 ; 46:2 , 19 , 20 ; 48:10 , 13 . 7 Aaronic priests. In H. it is taken for granted that a priest is of the seed of Aaron; the plural is never used; כֹּהֵן is used for any priest Lev 21:9 ; 22:10-11 , 12 , 13 ; הַכֹּהֵן for Aaron 21:21 , and for the official priest (acting for the priesthood, almost collective) 17:5-6 , 22:14 ; 23:10-11 , 20 (twice in verse); 27:8 (3 t. in verse); 27:11-12 , (twice in verse); 27:14 (twice in verse); 27:18 , 21 , 23 . The priests of P are אַהֲרֹן בְּנֵי 1:5 , 8 , 11 ; 2:2 ; 3:2 ; 21:1 ; Num 3:3 ; 10:8 ; Josh 21:19 ; so in Chronicles 2Chr 13:9-10 , 26:18 ; 29:21 ; 31:19 ; 35:14 (twice in verse); הַכֹּהֵן is used of Aaron 22 t., Eleazar 29 t., Phinehas Josh 22:30 and elsewhere; 180 t. of ministering priests, or Generic of the priests; הכהנים Lev 6:22 ; 7:6 ; 13:2 ; 16:33 ; Josh 4:16 ; כהן Lev 6:16 . Chronicles distinguishes וְהַלְוִיִּם הַכֹּהֲנִים 1Chr 13:2 ; 15:11 , 14 ; 23:2 ; 24:6 , 31 ; 28:13 , 21 ; 2Chr 8:15 ; 11:13 ; 13:9-10 , 23:4 ; 24:5 ; 29:4 ; 30:15 , 25 ; 31:2 (twice in verse); 31:4 , 9 ; 34:30 ; 35:8 , 18 (the variants without וְ 23:18 ; 30:27 are due to copyists' errors), Ezra 1:5 ; 2:70 ; 3:8 , 12 ; 6:20 ; 7:7 ; 8:29-30 , 9:1 ; Neh 7:72 ; 8:13 ; 11:3 ; 12:1 , 30 , 44 (twice in verse); 13:30 ; והכהנים הלוים 2Chr 19:8 ; 30:21 ; priests, Levites, and others 1Chr 9:2 ; Ezra 10:5 ; Neh 10:1 ; 10:29 ; 10:35 ; 11:20 ; לֵוִי בְּנֵי antith. to ׳הַכּ Ezra 8:15 ; הלוים עם אהרן בן הכהן Neh 10:39 ; (ה)כהנים in Chronicles 67 t. has the same reference, as also כֹּהֲנֵינוּ Ezra 9:7 ; Neh 9:32 , 34 ; כֹּהֵן Ezra 2:63 = Neh 7:65 ; ׳כ ליחוה 2Chr 26:17 ; כהניו His (God's) priests 13:12 ; ׳כ מוֺרֶה teaching priest 15:3 ; הַכֹּהֵן is used of Jehoiada in time of David 1Chr 27:5 , and Azariah in the reign of Uzziah 2Chr 26:17 . In the literature of the restoration הַכֹּהֵן is used of Ezra, Ezra 7:11 ; 10:10 , 16 ; Neh 8:2 , 9 ; 12:26 ; Uriah Ezra 8:33 ; Eliashib Neh 13:4 ; Shelemiah 13:13 ; הכהנים Joel 1:9 , 13 ; 2:17 ; Hag 2:11-12 , 13 ; Zech 7:5 ; Mal 1:6 ; 2:1 ; priests and prophets Zech 7:3 ; כהן Mal 2:7 . 8 the high priest: הַכֹּהֵן is frequently used (see 4 ) to designate the priest who was at the head of priestly affairs . The adjective הַגָּדוֺל first appears of Jehoiada 2Kin 12:11 , then of Hilkiah 22:4 , 8 ; 23:4 ; 2Chr 34:9 ; after the exile, of Joshua Hag 1:1 , 12 , 14 ; 2:2 , 4 ; Zech 3:1 , 8 ; 6:11 , and Eliashib Neh 3:1 , 20 ; 13:28 . But P uses it of Aaron and his eldest descendants who are anointed with holy oil Lev 21:10 (H; ׳הכ מֵאֶחָיו הַגָּדוֺל ), Num 35:25 , 28 (twice in verse); Josh 20:6 , and so ׳הַכּ הַמָּשִׁיחַ Lev 4:3 , 5 , 16 ; 6:15 , compare 16:32 . ׳כ הָראֹשׁ is used of Seraiah 2Kin 25:18 = Jer 52:24 ; and, in Chronicler, of Amariah 2Chr 19:11 , Jehoiada 24:11 , Azariah 26:20 ; 31:10 ; of Aaron, Ezra 7:5 . (We also supposes הרואה in 2Sam 15:27 to be a corruption of הראשׁ , which he regards as post-exilic insertion. The test is corrupt [see Dr Sm. 1.c .]; but this correction is improbable. Lists of high priests occur 1 Chronicles 5:30-41; 1Chr 6:35-38 .) A priest of second rank ( כֹּהֵן (ה)מִשְׁנֶה ) appears in 2Kin 23:4 (construct plural incorrect), 25:18 = Jer 52:24 ; הַכּ ׳זִקְנֵי 2Kin 19:2 = Isa 37:2 ; Jer 19:1 ; הַכּ ׳שָׂרֵי 2Chr 36:14 ; Ezra 8:24 , 29 ; 10:5 ; הַכּ ׳רָאשֵׁי Neh 12:7 .
